title: Central Sector And Centrally Sponsored Schemes
definition: Central Sector Schemes (CSS) are 100% funded and implemented by the Central Government, whereas Centrally Sponsored Schemes (CSS-sponsored) are jointly funded by the Centre and States with specific sharing patterns to execute national development priorities.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Prelims (budgetary allocations, funding patterns, nodal ministries) and Mains GS Paper II & III (Centre-State fiscal relations, cooperative federalism, implementation efficacy of welfare policies).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Central Sector And Centrally Sponsored Schemes.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Indian Polity - Federalism and Seventh Schedule
Indian Economy - Union Budget and Fiscal Policy
